name: eighteen-cosmos-server
description: Authoritative game server. Hosts RoomSession over WebSocket; decides nothing itself (design note #1210).

scripts._comment_build: INVOKED THROUGH `node`, NOT THROUGH THE .bin SHIM, AND THE REASON IS WINDOWS. `.bin/tsc` is a shell script; cmd.exe reads `../frontend/...` as a command it does not have and answers `'..' is not recognized`. `node <path>/bin/tsc` is the same compiler reached in a way every shell agrees about. Same family of fault as the `FOO=1 npm start` note in src/start.ts: an instruction that works for half its readers.
scripts._comment_test: LIVE-3A/3B/3C/2A/2B/2C/2D/2E, the LIVE-2F/3D certification regressions, ESCROW-3A (identity families + re-authentication, the settlement lifecycle, wallet tickets, operator recovery) and ESCROW-3B (the Juno backend: secp256k1/Cosmos-tx/ABI pins, the end-to-end money game on an offline chain, the adversarial matrix, the room host's escrow seam) and ESCROW-JOIN (the join admission: frozen vectors, wire, `authorizeJoin`, the ticket ledger) and ESCROW-4 (the ADR-036 wallet proof pinned to cosmjs; real-money tables end to end over production identity and the offline chain: W-13, R-J1, W-2, Start and its rollback, the consent/annul relay, relinks) and LIVE-4 L4-1 (the canonical compatibility model: the moved protocol constants, ESCROW-3A's money verdict reproduced by the canonical one, this build's capability key) and LIVE-4 L4-2 (no-money continuation wired: the dealing identity stamped, a money table dealt under its money identity end to end, the verdict at every load across releases, every derived 'no' written nowhere, the draining pool's serving review) and LIVE-4 L4-3 (client compatibility: the announcement read at the upgrade, the client verdict at the connection and per game at every hello, submit and push, reload / 4426, route answered as not continued here before LIVE-6, the legacy wire untouched and a retired one answered in its own frames) and LIVE-4 L4-4 (money continuation: the canonical verdict before every money write -- creation, another contract never held, the relayer's in-memory skip and its sequence guard, the coordinator's step -1, newer/older/corrupt financial artifacts, a configuration typo, a missing financial record, verification-grade chain facts, the operator's read-only classes; asserted on bytes) and LIVE-4 L4-5 (T-18: the hosted revenue seed is drawn by the production session factory's `crypto.randomInt` source, committed, replayed and reused -- never drawn again) and the LIVE-4 integration (one capability and one chain-facts runtime per process; the session and the money seams agree on every money fact -- another deployment and a configuration typo derived, a verified chain contradiction refused by both; N-3: a complete newer-format log line never truncated; a build change alone never refuses; the legacy wire keeps its compare) and LIVE-4 L4-6 (the operator's tooling: the canonical compatibility descriptor and its key, production's own, in the banner, `ops/status.json` and `gamesDoctor compat`; a BUILD_ID change moves only the diagnostic; every stored game's canonical continuation verdict through production's wiring, `gamesDoctor continuation`, agreeing with a running server's hello and the money seams; every inspection command byte-for-byte read-only) and the LIVE-4 L4-7 final certification (a verified chain contradiction against queued, admitted and in-flight gameplay: what was queued before it may commit, what arrives after it is refused on every resident game, and a money job in flight signs at most its one intent, never attempted on chain; a verified deployment conflict's durable hold outlives the process -- not continued until the chain is read again; several unreadable artifacts: one class, never a write; one key in the banner, `ops/status.json`, gamesDoctor, the sessions and the money serving, moved by no build id; the announcement parsed once per connection, and `/gs*` query strings kept by the edge; every stored-data class over file stores -- the operator, a server, its sweeps and a restart, bytes hashed -- and the release path; restarts and reconnects: no derived answer becomes a hold, no conflict disappears) and LIVE-5 L5-1 (the persistence conformance suites -- one behavioural suite per store port, run against every memory and file implementation, with deterministic fault injection; F-L5-4 pinned per port -- and the AWS client convention, with no network) and LIVE-5 L5-4 (the identity side's durable security ports -- sensitive-auth grants and the security-event journal -- against their reference models, and the identity service's substrate: every security change journaled FIRST -- after the store's own checks, never for a change the store refuses -- and confirmed once applied, an append that fails stops its change, durable grants reloaded at a restart and honoured exactly as before, and nothing new without the substrate): the per-game actor's regressions and the seeded stress run, against the compiled output -- run `npm run build` first. Explicit file paths rather than a directory or a glob, because `node --test` does not read either the same way on every Node version a playtest machine may have. `--test-concurrency=1` (LIVE-2F/3D): the files run one at a time, as every certified run did on its 2-CPU hosts -- several suites spawn real servers, race processes for one lock or wait on wall-clock limits, and a many-core machine otherwise runs all twenty at once.

scripts._comment_test_dynamodb_local: LIVE-5 L5-1: the DynamoDB-Local proof (the substrate, the DynamoDB semantics later slices rely on, and the financial-record conformance cases against a proof adapter). LIVE-5 L5-4: the DynamoDB identity adapter, its grants and the security-event journal as conformance subjects (every identity, grant and journal case, the fence inside every write, the lost-answer settlement), and its properties (random changes judged by the table's conditions alone against the memory verdict, a change of several transactions interrupted, the identity-writer role, every kind of damage, a table changed behind the writer, the identity service over DynamoDB with the substrate). NOT part of `npm test`: it needs DynamoDB Local running on this machine and GS_DYNAMODB_LOCAL_ENDPOINT naming it (a loopback http endpoint; anything else is refused), and fails with instructions without one. See server/src/aws/README.md. Run `npm run build` first.
scripts._comment_logDoctor: LIVE-3B: the offline operator tool for a room log the server holds as damaged. STOP THE SERVER FIRST. `npm run logDoctor -- data/JUNO-XXX.log.jsonl` inspects; add `--repair` (and `--split-poisoned` for the F-8 shape) to write a verified copy beside it. See claude/live3b-hardened-local-store-2026-09-25.md.
scripts._comment_gamesDoctor: LIVE-3C: the offline operator tool for a data directory's games. `npm run gamesDoctor -- status` works while the server runs, and so do the read-only `money`, `scan-v10`, `compat` (LIVE-4 L4-6: this build's canonical compatibility descriptor and key) and `continuation` (LIVE-4 L4-6: every stored game's canonical continuation verdict); `inspect [--deep]`, `release <game_id> --note "..."` and `gc [--apply]` refuse while a server holds the directory, and release/gc hold its lock themselves. See claude/live3c-restore-reconciliation-lifecycle-2026-09-27.md.
